title: Unrivaled Platform Portfolios
scenario: Find platforms that have exclusive games in every genre that exists in the database.
tableSchema: games (game_id INT, genre VARCHAR), ratings (game_id INT, platform VARCHAR)
hint: Use NOT EXISTS or division-like logic.
correctQuery: SELECT platform FROM ratings r JOIN games g ON r.game_id = g.game_id GROUP BY platform HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT g.genre) = (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT genre) FROM games);
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE games (game_id INT, genre VARCHAR); CREATE TABLE ratings (game_id INT, platform VARCHAR);
